Lecture Overview:
Why can't LLMs do everything on their own, and how do they learn to use tools? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, Stanford professor Diyi Yang covers the “lost in the middle” problem, how LLMs learn to use tools with Toolformer and ToolkenGPT, scaling to thousands of APIs with ToolLLM and Gorilla, the difference between REST APIs, function calling, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and how to evaluate tool use with BFCL, ToolBench, and -bench, plus common failure modes.
Speaker: Diyi Yang
